lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. Centroids are most concentrated in the mid-lateral band, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with approximately 4-5 visible vertical rows in the primary flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like structure. These intersections are most distinct in the region between the gills and the dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity (dorsal) to low-intensity (ventral) shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin exhibits several high-luminance blobs; however, light refraction at the water surface causes significant distortion and occlusion of the pattern in the upper half of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, roughly semi-circular indentation or notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Intense light caustic patterns from surface wave refraction are projected onto the mid-flank, creating temporal regions of high-intensity luminance that overlie the biological patterning.
